labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: New highlighting behaviour requested for ReprHighlighter; a feature request, so approval in Discussions is needed first.

body:
This is a feature request for new highlighting behaviour. Rich's [feature template](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) asks for new features to be approved in Discussions before an issue is opened, so please start the proposal there.

Until then, `ReprHighlighter` is a `RegexHighlighter` with a `highlights` list, so a subclass can add a unit pattern without changing Rich: see [rich/highlighter.py](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/highlighter.py).

Related earlier issue: #3318 (number highlight regex).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
